subject: general
question: The surface area of a sphere is 61600 sq. cm. Find the volume of the sphere (in cu m). [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** of a sphere in terms of **Surface Area (SA)** and **radius (r)** is given by: Volume = (SA × r) ÷ 3

First, find **radius**: r² = SA ÷ 4π = 61600 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 4900 ⇒ r = 70 cm.

Volume in cm³ = (61600 × 70) ÷ 3 = 4312000/3 cm³.

Convert to **m³** (1 m³ = 10⁶ cm³): (4312000/3) ÷ 1,000,000 = 4.312/3 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.312/3 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Surface Area** of sphere = 61600 cm²

**Value of π** = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area = 4πr²

Volume = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54b73ba1f90948818ddab0865e951bb1ed4509a507cc7d4c20b8e2c225c0078b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × r² = 61600

⇒ (88/7) × r² = 61600

⇒ r² = (61600 × 7) ÷ 88

⇒ r² = 700 × 7 = 4900

⇒ **r** = √4900 = 70 cm

⇒ Volume (V) = (4/3) × (22/7) × 70 × 70 × 70

⇒ V = (4/3) × 22 × 10 × 70 × 70

⇒ V = (88 × 49000) ÷ 3 = 4312000/3 cm³

To convert **cm³** to **m³**, divide by 10⁶ (since 1 m = 100 cm):

⇒ V = (4312000/3) ÷ 1,000,000

⇒ V = 4.312/3 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 4.312/3 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere and Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area of **Hemisphere** = 2πr²

Total Surface Area of **Hemisphere** = 3πr²

Volume of **Hemisphere** = (2/3)πr³

Unit Conversions

1 m² = 10,000 cm² | 1 m³ = 1,000,000 cm³</p
